text: Astronomy is the study of the universe, including stars, planets, galaxies, and other celestial bodies. Nebulae, clouds of gas and dust that emit light and heat, are an interesting aspect of astronomy. These clouds are visible to the naked eye as colorful patches in the night sky. To better observe and study these cosmic phenomena, astronomers use powerful telescopes, such as the Hubble Space Telescope. This has enabled us to learn more about the composition and structure of these elusive objects.
